notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.5
notes.content:
A few more bug fixes, with special thanks to Ventz Petkov for the great bug reporting!

[h2]Gameplay Fixes[/h2]

- Object collision fixes for things like the Western Tower entrance, lightning barrier, etc.

- The shield in the Freestad Caves should no longer be on the wrong layer.

- Leith's bed should now have physical form, preventing you from walking through it like a creeping ghost.

- When switching between mouse and gamepad or using the Steam Deck trackpad as a mouse, the player's toolbar should no longer switch selection when moving if the mouse was left resting over the toolbar.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay Fixes[/h2]

- Game should now correctly resume at fullscreen when returning from screensaver or alt-tab.

[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]

- Gamepad / Steam Deck users should now see tile highlighting when farming to help with your farm layout and seed placement.

notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]

- [b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b] : Synching games across platforms and devices should now be possible via Steam Cloud. To ensure you have this functionality enabled, open Steam and click Steam -> Settings -> Cloud.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

- Naval combat victories should now correctly update the coins displayed from the coins you get as plunder.

notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay FIxes[/h2]
- Fixed surface rendering and mouse coordinates in windowed and widescreen modes.

- Steam Deck ocean optimizations

- Cave tile fixes

[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
- Better quest descriptions for initial Pirate and Global Trade quests.

- Improved mushroom hit box

- Expanded melee hit box

- Goblin boss damage decreased from 10 to 9

notes.title: Dreaming Isles Demo and Next Fest Update
notes.content:
Hi all!

I'm getting closer to completing the playable demo for Dreaming Isles. It should be ready by the new year, but possibly sooner. Dreaming Isles will be in the February Next Fest, so I plan to get the demo out well ahead of that. I want to get plenty of testing, feedback, and debugging done prior to the fest!

I'm a solo developer, a dad of two, and a full-time worker, so it's hard to give exact dates. Thank you so much to everyone who has followed and wishlisted Dreaming Isles! It's been my dream to do this for decades, and I'm grateful for all of your support!

Sincerely,
YawningDad
